authority.scope: Materialize the existing source-backed Administrative Syndicate stable identity at an exact canonical object version. This does not create a second faction and does not promote the separately owner-authored East Gate jurisdiction relation into recovered-source fact.

records.name: The Administrative Syndicate
records.composition: A governing body composed of Mandated Corporations chosen by the Kosmer Royal Family.
records.sourceSupportedAuthority: Mandated Corporations are granted formal dominion over specific aspects of Vertigon's operation and governance.
records.oversight: Mandated Corporations remain answerable to the Throne and Goblifex scrutiny; the source also describes quarterly audits and reality-compliance reporting to the Imperial Bureau of Oversight.
explicitNonClaims: This source-backed identity does not itself establish routine East Gate jurisdiction.
This identity does not imply sovereignty over every Vertigon institution or route.
This identity does not imply corruption, control of Black Feathers, ownership of the Lantern Compact, or control of the full East Transit Spine.
